name: claude-proxy-web
description: Optional, read-only local web search and fetch tools backed by Claude Proxy. Only for client sessions and organizations that authorize local MCP tools and requested destinations.

proxy_port.title: Local Claude Proxy port
proxy_port.description: The port shown in Claude Proxy > Claude clients; default 18181.

gateway_token.title: Local Claude Proxy MCP token
gateway_token.description: Bearer token generated by Claude Proxy. Treat as sensitive. The extension uses it only for loopback 127.0.0.1.

tools.name: claude_proxy_web_search
tools.description: Read-only, source-linked public web search through the configured Claude Proxy route.

tools.name: claude_proxy_web_fetch
tools.description: Read-only public page fetch with explicit source URL and honest retrieval failure.
